perk.definition:
n an incidental benefit awarded for certain types of employment (especially if it is regarded as a right)
v gain or regain energy
perk.translation:
vi. 昂首, 振作, 举止高傲, 神气活现, 滤煮
vt. 竖起, 打扮, 使振作, 滤煮
n. 小费

perked.translation: v. （使）活跃( perk的过去式和过去分词 ); （使）增值; 使更有趣

perkeratosis.translation: 牲畜X病, 牲畜皮肤角化症

perkier.definition: s. characterized by liveliness and lightheartedness
perkier.translation: a. 得意扬扬的( perky的比较级 ); 神气的; 活泼的; 有生气的

perkiest.definition: s. characterized by liveliness and lightheartedness
perkiest.translation: a. 得意扬扬的( perky的最高级 ); 神气的; 活泼的; 有生气的

perkin.definition: n. A kind of weak perry.

perkiness.definition:
n cheerfulness that bubbles to the surface
n inappropriate playfulness
perkiness.translation: n. 得意洋洋；精力充沛；因自信而流露的喜悦

perking.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Perk
perking.translation: v. （使）活跃( perk的现在分词 ); （使）增值; 使更有趣

perkinism.definition:
n. A remedial treatment, by drawing the pointed extremities
   of two rods, each of a different metal, over the affected part;
   tractoration, -- first employed by Dr. Elisha Perkins of Norwich, Conn.
   See Metallotherapy.
perkinism.translation: [医] 珀金斯氏疗法(使用金属牵引器的治病法,一种江湖医术)

perks.definition:
n an incidental benefit awarded for certain types of employment (especially if it is regarded as a right)
v gain or regain energy
perks.translation:
n. 特权；额外津贴（perk的复数）；特别待遇
n. (Perks)人名；(英)珀克斯；(法)佩尔克
v. 打扮；使振作；昂首挺胸（perk的第三人称单数）

perky.definition: s characterized by liveliness and lightheartedness
perky.translation: a. 得意洋洋的, 快活的, 敏捷的, 美观的, 傲慢的, 神气的
